title: Postgres upgrade window
transcript:
[00:00] Amara: The Postgres upgrade. We agreed on a maintenance window, right?
[00:05] Felix: Saturday the 7th, from 6 to 8 a.m. Central European Time.
[00:10] Amara: That's when traffic is lowest. Who's running it?
[00:14] Felix: Me. Siobhan is backup if something goes wrong.
[00:18] Amara: What's the rollback plan?
[00:20] Felix: We take a snapshot at 5:45. If the upgrade fails, we restore it. That takes about twenty minutes.
[00:26] Amara: Then the status page goes up on Thursday, two days before.
[00:31] Felix: I'll post it Thursday and email the five biggest customers directly.
[00:35] Amara: Good. And send me a short summary on Monday, even if everything goes fine.
[00:41] Felix: Will do. Monday, summary to you.
